skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap ssh scripts and capture host keys

skill_cards.then_action: Attempt anonymous SMB enumeration and default credential login via crackmapexec

skill_cards.then_action: Use Burp Suite to spider endpoints and lookup known CVEs for version
